deploy.startCommand: bash -lc 'if [ "${WHOS_ACTIVATION_PROBE_ON_START:-false}" = "true" ]; then python -c "import asyncio; from agno.agent import Agent; from app.settings import default_model; print(\"WHOS_AGENTOS_ACTUAL_START work_id=WHOS-AGENTOS-ACTIVATION-R1\", flush=True); r=asyncio.run(Agent(id=\"whos-option-a-probe\", model=default_model()).arun(\"Return exactly 42 and nothing else.\")); c=str(r.content).strip(); print(f\"WHOS_AGENTOS_REAL_WORK work_id=WHOS-AGENTOS-ACTIVATION-R1 result={c}\", flush=True); assert c == \"42\", c; print(\"WHOS_AGENTOS_TERMINAL work_id=WHOS-AGENTOS-ACTIVATION-R1 status=VERIFIED_SUCCESS\", flush=True)" || echo "WHOS_AGENTOS_PROBE_FAILED"; fi; exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'
